name: Breeze Bounce
description: A light seed floats on the breeze. Bounce it off a leaf to release soft dandelion clocks. No lives: a missed seed just drifts back in from the top.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A light seed floats and bounces. Move a leaf under it and let it touch the dandelion clocks to release them.
help.goal: Release every dandelion. There are no lives: a missed seed drifts back down from the top after a short pause, and the number of drifts is only counted, never judged.
howToPlay: Slide the leaf left and right to catch the seed and bounce it back up.
Where the seed lands on the leaf changes the angle it leaves at.
Every dandelion the seed touches is released.
When all dandelions are released the round ends and shows your time and your best time. Pausing stops the clock.
Press Play again for a new layout. Each round has a different layout.

controls.action: Start or resume after the Ready prompt
Reach the on-screen Left, Right and New round buttons

tips: Hit the seed with the edge of the leaf to send it sideways to far dandelions.
Reduced motion makes the seed slower and turns off the drifting particles.
You can stop at any time. Your round is saved and waits for you.
